VBO:0201098.summary: Affectionate and easy to train in her owner’s account, one-year-old Jasmine is a Pugapoo, a Pug–Poodle cross, who likes sleeping under blankets. Another adult, Maggie, is described as keen on people, especially children. Their owners report different coats: Jasmine sheds fine hairs, while Maggie needs regular grooming.
VBO:0201098.shortDescription: A Pug–Poodle cross, with named adults enjoying people and sleeping under blankets; owners describe differing coat care.
